set.body: Slice of bd-01M3HHR5QV9W9SS9AMM1RR1SM0: laws intentionally keeps test/law libraries in main scope and skips commonSettings, so its forked JVM omits forkHandshakeOptions. Share the option-only settings without adding test dependencies; verify actual default lawsJVM forks and the audit runJVMOptions preservation, and retain CI behavior. The parent still requires its complete uninterrupted default-gate evidence.
set.title: Apply the local fork-handshake policy to published-law test JVMs
